single_dose: adults 0.25 mg - 4 mg, given 2 or 3 times daily
dosage_frequency: twice a day || three times a day

indication: anxiety or anxiety with associated depressive symptomatology
mechanism_of_action: depresses the central nervous system, enhancing the action of GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid)
side_effects: sedation, withdrawal symptoms in breastfed neonates and infants, dizziness, drowsiness, amnestic reactions, cognitive impairments
unsuitable_population: children, elderly, pregnant women, patients with renal impairment, alcoholic liver disease, patients with hepatic impairment
